lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Good day, Tenerife! You're listening to Radio Tenerify — I'm Alex, here with Mia, and it is a gorgeous Wednesday out there.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: It really is! We're sitting at 27 degrees under clear blue skies down in the south — weather code zero, which basically means not a cloud in sight. Classic Tenerife summer.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Perfect beach weather. Now, we did want to flag briefly — there was a serious road accident over in Lanzarote a few weeks back involving a tourist bus, with two fatalities. A sad reminder to everyone to stay careful on the roads out here.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Absolutely. Our thoughts go out to those affected. On a brighter note though — if you're heading up to Santa Cruz this weekend, you are in for a treat!

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Yes! The Urban Beach Festival is happening Saturday the 25th down at the Puerto de Santa Cruz, with Beéle bringing his Borondo Tour to the island.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: And then Sunday the 26th, Kapo makes his very first Tenerife appearance at the Parking del Palmetum. First time on the island — that's a big deal!

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Check the webtenerife website for tickets and details. That's all from us for now — enjoy that sunshine, stay safe, and we'll catch you soon on Radio Tenerify!
